{"code": "df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '', regex=False).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check if 'converted' is binary
print('Unique values in converted:', df['converted'].unique())

# Check revenue distribution
print('Revenue summary:')
print(df['revenue'].describe())

# Check for sentinel values
print('Sentinel values in revenue:', df['revenue'].isin([0, -1, -999]).sum())

# Check for outliers using IQR
Q1 = df['revenue'].quantile(0.25)
Q3 = df['revenue'].quantile(0.75)
IQR = Q3 - Q1
lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
outliers = df[(df['revenue'] < lower_bound) | (df['revenue'] > upper_bound)]
print(f'Outliers count: {len(outliers)}')

# Check if 'channel' has a 'campaign' group
print('Channel values:', df['channel'].unique())

# Check if 'status' has a 'converted' status
print('Status values:', df['status'].unique())

# Check if 'converted' corresponds to 'status' == 'converted'
conversion_match = (df['converted'] == (df['status'] == 'converted')).all()
print('Conversion status matches converted column:', conversion_match)"}
